shared_elements: registers separated by plain horizontal fillets
low-relief carved ornament on a wall face
repeated stylized floral/palmette-like ornament in a frieze
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief architectural friezes organized into stacked horizontal registers, and both include the same specific motif of a continuous row of multi-petalled rosettes bounded by plain fillets, with stylized vegetal/palmette-like and stepped geometric ornament nearby. The chief difference is that A also carries figural narrative content (a horse-drawn chariot and a procession of robed, capped human figures) that is entirely absent from B, which is purely ornamental.
